MEMBERS OF THE FEDERAL INVESTIGATION AGENCY
MEMBERS OF THE FEDERAL INVESTIGATION AGENCY
(EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE) RULES, 1978
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 28th March 1978]
S. R. O. 336 (Il/78.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 9 of the Federal Investigation Agency
Act, 1974 (VIII of 1975), the Federal Govern ment is pleased to make the
following rules, namely :‑‑
1. Short title, commencement and application.‑(1) These rules
may be called the Members of the Federal Investigation Agency (Efficiency and
Discipline) Rules, 1978.
(2) They shall come into force
at once and shall apply to every member of the Agency.
2. Application of Government Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 1973.‑The
Government Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 1973, shall apply to the
members of the Agency and in such application shall have effect as if, in the
said Rules,‑
(a) for the words
"Government Servant", wherever occurring, the words "member of
the Agency" were substituted;
(b) in rule 2. in clause (4),
the words, brackets, comma and figure "or contrary to Government Servants
(Conduct) Rules, 1964" were omitted;
(c) rule 9 were omitted;
(d) in rule 10, for the words, figure, brackets and comma
"under Part XIII of the Civil Service (Classification, Control and Appeal)
Rules" the words "by the Federal Government" were substituted;
and
(e) rule 11 were omitted.
